# Panel Slide

**Cover › Panel** · v1.0.0 · 40 frames at 30 fps (20–80)

Solid bars slide in one after another to cover the frame, then carry on out the other side to show the next scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/panel-slide@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/panel-slide@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Corporate and broadcast looks
- Lower-energy section breaks
- Slide decks

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import panelSlide from './transitions/04-cover/panel/panel-slide';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(panelSlide, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 40 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `colors` | colors | `["#111111","#F1EFEA","#FF4F1A"]` |  | Panel colours in order; the last one ends on top, so make it the incoming scene's background colour. |
| `direction` | enum | `"left"` | `left` · `right` · `up` · `down` | Direction the motion travels. |
| `stagger` | number | `0.12` | 0–0.3 | Delay between bars, as a share of each phase. |
| `hold` | number | `0.1` | 0–0.4 | Share of the transition spent fully covered. |
